title: Coordination can stall silently when every session waits on a message nobody is due to send
outcome: TermAl work does not sit idle for long stretches because every session is waiting on a message that no session is due to send; such a stall is either prevented or surfaced to the coordinator within a bounded time.
acceptance: Coordination can stall silently when every session waits on a message nobody is due to send is done
